name: VisualCOMET: Visual Commonsense Graphs
description: VisualCOMET is a visual commonsense reasoning benchmark providing structured inferences about the dynamic temporal and social context of static scenes. Comprising 1,465,704 textual commonsense inferences across 59,356 complex images from movie frames, it models what happened before the picture, what characters intend at present, and what is likely to occur next.

license.notes: Commonsense graph annotations and model weights released by the Allen Institute for AI for non-commercial research use. Underlying movie frames are inherited from the Visual Commonsense Reasoning (VCR) dataset, originating from commercial films owned by copyright holders; strictly restricted to academic non-commercial research.
